grade.title: GPA & GPAX calculator
grade.lead: Calculate your GPA by subject or cumulative GPAX quickly, clearly, and for free. Built by Podsawee Wanatham for students using the Thai grading system.
grade.calculatorIntro: Enter subjects and credits for GPA, or prior results for cumulative GPAX. Your data stays in this browser.
grade.subject: Subject
grade.empty: Enter at least one subject with credits.
grade.featuresTitle: Everything you need to calculate grades
grade.feature1Body: Enter each grade and credit value; the calculator applies the correct weighted average instantly.
grade.feature2Body: Combine an existing GPA and credits with the current term to estimate your new cumulative result.
grade.feature3Body: Use it on phone, tablet, or computer without downloading an application.
grade.step1Body: Use GPA for subjects in one term, or GPAX to combine results across terms.
grade.step2Body: Add the values shown on your real transcript. You can add or remove subject rows as needed.
grade.step3Body: The calculator shows the weighted average and total credits so you can plan your studies.
grade.faq1A: Yes. It is free in your web browser with no download or installation.
grade.faq2Q: What is the difference between GPA and GPAX?
grade.faq2A: GPA is an average for a defined study period. GPAX is a cumulative average across multiple terms.
grade.faq3Q: Can I use it on a phone?
grade.faq3A: Yes. The page is designed for phones, tablets, and computers.
